{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
qa_count = qa_mask.sum()
data_clean = data[~qa_mask].copy()

# Remove refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
refunded_mask = data_clean['status'] == 'refunded'
data_final = data_clean[~refunded_mask].copy()

# Check for non-random channel assignment: cross-tabulate channel vs customer_segment
cross_tab = pd.crosstab(data_final['channel'], data_final['customer_segment'])
print('Customer segment distribution by channel:')
print(cross_tab)

# Calculate conversion rate and mean revenue by channel
conversion_by_channel = data_final.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
mean_revenue_by_channel = data_final.groupby('channel')['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Calculate overall conversion rate
overall_conversion = data_final['converted'].mean()

# Summary
print(f'\nConversion rate (email): {conversion_by_channel["email"]:.4f}')
print(f'Conversion rate (paid_search): {conversion_by_channel["paid_search"]:.4f}')
print(f'Mean revenue (email): ${mean_revenue_by_channel["email"]:.2f}')
print(f'Mean revenue (paid_search): ${mean_revenue_by_channel["paid_search"]:.2f}')
print(f'Overall conversion rate: {overall_conversion:.4f}')"}
